scope: Interprovincial energy trade, physical provincial balances and bounded price sensitivities

data.tradeUnit: million current CAD at basic prices

model.trade: Uniform commodity repricing at fixed quantities: change in receipts = exports × shock; change in purchase costs = imports × shock. Every selected province uses all domestic counterparties. Domestic net balances cancel as an accounting identity, not as a GDP result.
model.fiscal: The same percentage changes each published provincial benchmark from its own dated baseline. Alberta oil and gas, British Columbia gas, and Saskatchewan oil use separate budget sensitivities. BC includes production and royalty-credit responses. The fiscal and trade channels overlap and must not be added.
model.bounds: One commodity and one percentage change, between -20% and +20%, per AI analysis. Native controls recalculate without inference.
model.missing: Suppressed or unavailable values remain null. Missing fiscal calibrations are not zero. Physical totals do not identify bilateral shipments.

refresh.trade: Official Statistics Canada ZIP downloads on scheduled refresh and deployment; dimension, completeness, missingness, reconciliation and source hashes verified before atomic output.
refresh.fiscal: Verify the exact publisher files on every refresh. Changed hashes stop publication for review of the coefficients.

architecture.planner: The language model selects topics and regions. Explicit supported periods, commodities and price signs are reconciled against the request. Unsupported measures retain a coverage note.
architecture.presentation: Jev receives bounded panel metadata; OpenUI renders registered components. Model output does not supply numerical estimates or executable UI code.
architecture.reproducibility: Browser exports contain resolved panels, selection, pinned source datasets and source registry.
